helpers.name: InitNumberBitsSet
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Plain void function with no this parameter, not a C++ constructor. Writes all 16 existing number_bits_set entries on each observed invocation.

helpers.name: activate_deflect
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Four specialized instances forward events 0x6d,0x71,0x74 with a null target definition. Parameter forwarding outside that observed domain is a source reconstruction.

helpers.name: check_for_equipment_targets_impl
helpers.reconstruction_notes: ORs flags with 5 and calls can_target; player/card have no remaining instructions.

helpers.name: goad
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Creates the goad_effect legacy. The caller discards the result; the abstract return type is int.

helpers.name: find_imprint_legacy
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Each expansion initializes an index to zero and passes its address to find_imprint_legacy_next.

helpers.name: disable_legend_rule_impl
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Preserves unsigned native tests selecting player0 for 0/2, player1 for 1/2 and neither for other values.

helpers.name: phyrexians
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Loses life before drawing cards, following native callee identities; amounts 1 and 2 are observed.

helpers.name: is_this_dying_or_being_exiled
helpers.reconstruction_notes: in_play first, then a fresh instance lookup and the unsigned byte range kill_code 1..4.

helpers.name: generate_encore_token
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Sets token legacy byte at offset42 and special_code_for_legacy pointer at offset60 to encore_legacy.

helpers.name: get_updated_casting_cost_with_cost_mod
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Subtracts the cost modification before true_get_updated_casting_cost, then clamps negative results to zero; generic cless/cost_mod combinations outside observed callers are not independently proven.

helpers.name: add_force_a_subtype_permanently
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Only mode1 survives in the native caller. Storing the abstract mode parameter is inferred from the parallel until-EOT helper and legacy field semantics; other modes are not independently proven. Preserves unguarded lookup and token_status assignment rather than OR.

helpers.name: add_force_a_subtype_until_eot_impl
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Mode1 and mode2 instances each perform two get_card_instance calls, then store subtype; no failed-creation guard is added.

helpers.name: destr_read_a_line
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Splits at LF in place and advances by one; missing-LF paths terminate the consumer. Leaves the cursor unchanged on missing LF in this source reconstruction; that cursor is dead on native failure paths.

helpers.name: can_legally_play_iid_now_lite
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Instant/interrupt bypass sorcery timing; land still checks land_can_be_played bit1 and current_turn.

helpers.name: retrieve_stored_iids_and_tou
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Compacts target pairs into signed16 arrays, scanning from pos to target9. Observed pos0/1; no assertion is added.

helpers.name: clear_stored_iids_and_tou
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Clears card then player through target9. Observed pos0/1.

helpers.name: can_pay_aftermath
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Observed event is EVENT_GRAVEYARD_ABILITY (0xb0). Forwarding the abstract event outside that domain is not independently proven.

helpers.name: exile_and_give_elemental
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Exiles before generating a 4/4 Elemental for the target controller; forced color byte0x14 is retained exactly.

helpers.name: create_hofri_token
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Preserves default destination player and packed tracking word, original_iid in high bits and owner in low nibble; it does not redirect the generated token to owner. In observed callers the packed word already exists before the attributed inline range.

helpers.name: create_targetted_legacy_effect_replace
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Finds the repeat legacy with (-1,player), exiles previous.card under source player if not-1, then creates its replacement.

helpers.name: find_any_attached_legacy_effect
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Scans only target_player_id battlefield in ascending order, requiring the custom-legacy iid, callback and exact attachment; returns the first card or-1.

helpers.name: validate_imprinted_card
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Looks up the first imprint legacy and exiles it when its stored iid is absent from the stored owner exile zone.

helpers.name: archon_of_cruelty_effect
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Opponent-validity guard surrounds sacrifice, discard, opponent life loss, own draw and own life gain, in that order.

scope: Restore23 original static helper definitions in their original source units. Native inline fragments, abstract/instance contracts, complete caller ranges and unchanged existing source caller definitions are pinned. General parameter forwarding and dead result/cursor behavior cannot always be uniquely determined from specialized native instances: per-helper notes explicitly record these reconstruction limits. The caller code remains expanded, so these source APIs do not introduce new native entries or change runtime behavior. No gameplay-equivalence claim is made.
